# WordDex

> WordDex is a language-learning app for iOS that turns real-world words into full interactive lessons. Tagline: "Fun lessons from your world."

WordDex is built for learners who have basic familiarity with a language and want to practice vocabulary from their everyday environment — menus, signs, manga, subtitles, product labels — not just from a fixed curriculum.

## How it works

1. See a word in real text
2. Scan it with your camera
3. WordDex automatically builds a 12-round lesson (matching, fill-in-the-blank, sentence building, speaking)
4. The word joins your personal Dex for spaced repetition review

## Key differentiators

- Lessons built from YOUR words, not a textbook sequence
- Full 12-round lessons, not just definitions or flashcards
- Pre-loaded exam decks for JLPT, TOEIC, and TOPIK (first topics free)
- 15+ languages supported
- Free to start daily; Premium for unlimited practice

## Who it's for

- Learners who finished beginner courses but struggle with real-world text
- People living in or traveling to countries where their target language is spoken
- Manga readers, K-drama watchers, and media consumers who want to learn words as they encounter them
- JLPT, TOEIC, and TOPIK exam candidates
